SELECT re.exchange_id AS exchangeId, re.member_id AS memberId, re.reward_id AS rewardId, re.point_used AS pointUsed, re.status AS status, re.exchanged_at AS exchangedAt, re.processed_at AS processedAt,
r.reward_name AS rewardName, r.reward_name_korean AS rewardNameKorean, r.image_url AS imageUrl FROM reward_exchange re JOIN reward r ON re.reward_id = r.reward_id WHERE re.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY re.exchange_id desc

SELECT re.exchange_id AS exchangeId, re.member_id AS memberId, re.reward_id AS rewardId, re.point_used AS pointUsed, re.status AS status, re.exchanged_at AS exchangedAt, re.processed_at AS processedAt,
r.reward_name AS rewardName, r.reward_name_korean AS rewardNameKorean, r.image_url AS imageUrl FROM reward_exchange re JOIN reward r ON re.reward_id = r.reward_id WHERE re.exchange_id = #{exchangeId}

SELECT re.exchange_id AS exchangeId, re.member_id AS memberId, re.reward_id AS rewardId, re.point_used AS pointUsed, re.status AS status, re.exchanged_at AS exchangedAt, re.processed_at AS processedAt,
r.reward_name AS rewardName, r.reward_name_korean AS rewardNameKorean, r.image_url AS imageUrl,
rr.name AS name, rr.phone AS phone, rr.address AS address, rr.address_detail AS addressDetail
FROM reward_exchange re
JOIN reward r ON re.reward_id = r.reward_id
LEFT JOIN reward_request rr ON re.exchange_id = rr.exchange_id
ORDER BY re.exchange_id DESC
